accountsNote: Current balances, closed accounts dimmed. Owed balances count as negative.
byCategoryNote: Spending by category, net of refunds, excluding transfers. Split transactions count under each split's category.
byMonthNote: Last 12 months, excluding transfers. Click a bar to see that month's categories.
conflict: This transaction changed since it loaded, save was aborted. Try again.
failAddConnector: Add the Clyde connector in your AI app's settings, then come back to this view.
failBlocked: Your organization's settings don't let this view read Clyde.
failChooseConnector: You have more than one Clyde connector. Choose the one this view reads when you're asked.
failed: Clyde couldn't read this. Try again in a moment.
failNoAnswer: Clyde didn't answer. Try again in a moment.
failNoConnector: This view reads your ledger through the Clyde connector, which it can't reach here. Open it as an artifact in your AI app with the Clyde connector added.
failPermission: This view needs your permission to read your ledger. Allow it when you're asked.
failRefused: Clyde couldn't do this. Try again in a moment.
failSignIn: Your Clyde connector needs you to sign in again. Reconnect it in your AI app's settings, then come back to this view.
failUserChanged: You signed in as someone else. Reload the page to see that ledger.
payeeEmpty: A payee can't be empty. Type one, or Cancel to keep it as it was.
scopeConfirm: This moves the transaction from :from to :to. Save again to confirm.
tagDuplicate: That tag is already on this transaction.
tagLimit: A transaction can have at most :max tags.
